{{Quote|The Emperor commands you to make contact with him.''"<br />"''Move the ship out of the asteroid field, so we can send a clear transmission.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Piett]], speaking with Lord Vader|<ref name="TESB" />}}
This '''holoprojection chamber''' was located on board the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] adjacent to [[Darth Vader's meditation chamber/Legends|Darth Vader's meditation chamber]]. The chamber contained a [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] transceiver<ref name="Rise and Fall">''[[The Rise and Fall of Darth Vader]]''</ref> [[HoloNet transceiver/Legends|projection pod]] with which [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] communicated with [[Palpatine/Legends|The Emperor]] via a secret frequency.<ref name="Visage of the Emperor">{{CCG|set=Dagobah Limited|cardname=Visage Of The Emperor}}</ref>

Commanding [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]] to move the ''Executor'' out of the [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|Hoth asteroid field]], Vader retired to his private chambers until the ship was clear. Stepping down from his meditation chamber, Vader strode down a short flight of stairs towards the hologram projection pod where he knelt down on his left knee to hear his master's bidding. His master then informed him of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] growing Force potential, and thus the growing threat he represents to their plans. Vader suggested turning him to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]].<ref name="TESB" /> He later utilized the chamber shortly after his [[Duel on Cloud City/Legends|failed capture]] of Luke Skywalker, just after intercepting a transmission from a suspected location of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] fleet.<ref name="SOTE1">[[Shadows of the Empire 1|''Shadows of the Empire'' 1]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In the game ''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike'', the ending of the levels [[Attack on Yavin 4|Revenge of Yavin]], [[Mission to Dantooine|Defiance on Dantooine]], [[Defense of Ralltiir|Defenders of Ralltiir, Extraction from Ralltiir]], [[Raid at Bakura]], [[Battle of Geonosis (Galactic Civil War)|Relics of Geonosis]], and [[Fondor shipyard assault|Fondor Shipyard Assault]] had [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] communicating with Palpatine via a similar chamber to the one onboard the ''Executor'', although it is left ambiguous as to whether it was intended to be the same holoprojection chamber or not.<ref name="SW:RSIII:RS">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref>
